_readme: Atlas's stock spoken lines. Edit freely: the dashboard re-reads this file on the next turn. Lines are dealt like a shuffled deck, so none repeats until the rest of its group has played. Put a line in 'retired' to stop it being said without deleting it. 'never_say' is what the model itself must not say: it is told so every turn, and a spoken sentence that opens with one has it trimmed off. Keep lines short and plain: no *, _, # or backticks. Words in {curly brackets} are filled in by the dashboard (the time, a name, a count): keep them as they are. Say 'don't say that again' to retire the stock line Atlas last used.
ack_question: Now there's a thing. Let me see.
Bear with me, I'll find out.
Let me have a proper look.
ack_task: Your wish, my command. Within reason.
ack_lookup: Let me go and find out.
long_wait: Bear with me, this one's chewy.
Still going. It's thinking quite hard.
Bit of a faff, this one. Nearly there.
longer_wait: This one's taking its sweet time.
Still working. Might be time to put the kettle on.
Taking longer than I'd like. Hang in there.
Bigger job than it looked. Still on it.
Still going. Worth the wait, hopefully.
handoff: On it. I've handed that to a helper and I'll tell you when it lands.
That's with a helper now. I'll shout when it lands.
Delegated. Carry on, I'll flag it when it's done.
Passed to a helper. You'll hear from me when it's sorted.
Right, a helper's on that. I'll let you know when it's in.
Handed off. Kettle on, I'll report back.
job_failed: Bad news, that one didn't make it.
No luck with that one, I'm afraid.
didnt_catch: Didn't catch that. Yes or no?
Sorry, was that a yes or a no?
greet_late: Burning the midnight oil, I see.
I'm here if you need me.
Shouldn't you be asleep? Anyway, I'm here.
The quiet hours. Best time to get things done, or so I'm told.
Up late again. What needs doing?
Night shift, then. I'm with you.
greet_morning: What are we working on today?
Fresh day, fresh chaos. Where do we start?
Morning. Let's see what the day has in store.
A new day. I've kept the place tidy overnight.
Morning. Tea first, or straight to it?
Up and about. Where shall we start?
Good to have you back. What's first?
greet_afternoon: Afternoon. How's the day treating you so far?
Back at it. What do you need?
The afternoon stretch. What's left on the list?
Good timing. What are we tackling?
greet_evening: Still at it? Admirable. What's next?
Evening. Winding down, or one last push?
Good evening. What's still on your mind?
Evening. Anything to tie up before tomorrow?
The evening shift. I'm all ears.
error: That one didn't go through, I'm afraid. The reason is on screen.
Something went wrong with that. I've put the details on screen.
No luck. It fell over part way, and the error is on screen.
That failed, I'm sorry to say. Have a look at the screen for why.
Hit a snag there. The details are on screen, and we can have another go.
time: Just gone {time}. {day}, in case that had slipped by too.
who: I'm Atlas, {whose} chief of staff. I keep an eye on the shop, the notes and the helpers, and I do the legwork so you can do the thinking.
Atlas. I run the back office: orders, notes, research, the odd awkward job. You point, I sort it out.
I'm Atlas, {whose} right hand. I look things up, keep the brain in order, send helpers off on the long jobs and tell you how it all went.
cleared: Screen's clear. I still remember what we were talking about.
Cleared. The conversation's intact, it's only the screen that's tidy.
All clear on screen. We carry on where we were.
fresh: Fresh start. The slate's clean, so what are we doing?
New conversation, then. Where shall we begin?
Right, clean sheet. What's on your mind?
noted: Noted. It's in this month's quick notes.
That's in the brain now, under today's date.
Written down. You'll find it in your quick notes.
Noted, and safely out of your head.
added: Done, it's on the end of {note}.
nothing_running: Nothing running in the background at the moment.
No helpers out at present. It's just the two of us.
All quiet. Nothing's running in the background.
retired_line: Fair enough. You won't hear "{line}" again.
talk_brief: Right, short and to the point from here.
Brief it is. Say the word when you want the long version back.
talk_chatty: Gladly. I'll talk things through properly from now on.
Right you are, I'll give you the fuller version from here on.
never_say: Let me help you with that
